images.prompt: Professional B2B corporate logo: a sleek minimalist drone quadcopter icon paired with the text EMS Drone in bold modern sans-serif typography. The drone icon is geometric and clean, the text is aligned to the right of the icon in a single horizontal lockup. Dark theme optimized - white and signal-green color scheme on pure black background. White drone icon, green accent line, EMS Drone text in white. Clean tight composition filling the entire 1024x1024 square canvas edge to edge. No empty space, no wasted margins, no decorative elements. Professional aerospace tech brand identity style.
